text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi safely ran through all three years.
And now—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Pencil case, check. Notebook, check.
Smartphone is—
choice_data_list: You've just been leaving it on the charger right there!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa, that was close!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Tsuru-chan!
The regular meeting's gonna start!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Right now! I'm coming out right now!
I'm done getting ready!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Trainer, I'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So you two have arrived.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, Tokai Teio!
Both present and accounted for!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: A future Student Council President candidate, that is!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Could you please give me some guidance right away!
About how you, Madam President, envision shaping the future!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"For our sake,
as we forge the future of the next generation!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
...Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I shall entrust it to you all.
Everything that I have envisioned.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After seeing Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi off,
I remained in the room and looked around.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So much happened in this room.
Devising training menus for Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi,
thinking about the next goals...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
My, aren't you a bit too young
to be lost in sentimental reminiscing~?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho-ho.
Allow me to say this as someone with more life experience:
If you have time to stand around—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: It's time to study!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I'm hoooome... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Teacher and... Trainer?
What's going on, wearing headbands and all?
choice_data_list: I am... studying English right now...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho-ho.
Let's do our best~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa, so many reference books...!
Why English all of a sudden...?
choice_data_list: Just in case Tsuyoshi ever wants to go on an overseas expedition

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho-ho.
We are Tsurumaru-san's supporters, after all.
choice_data_list: No matter what happens, whatever the future holds, I'll support you.
No matter what happens, whatever the future holds, I'll support you.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—For my sake?
.........

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe... Fuhehe.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Just as I thought,
you really are my greatest ally.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Um. Doctor, Trainer!
My future ahead may still be uncertain, but—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
In the future ahead,
I'll still be laughing with all of you!
Yes—it'll definitely become an "Absolute"!
